Design Aesthetics & Specifications:
- Style: Modern corporate SaaS aesthetic with premium e-learning polish (Linear, Stripe, Coursera/Udemy Business quality). Clean, trustworthy, professional, no flashy neon gradients, no oversized cards.
- Background & palette: Slate-50 (#F8FAFC) canvas, crisp white (#FFFFFF) cards with rounded-xl (12px), subtle slate-200 borders, soft shadows, 8px grid rhythm. Primary indigo-600 (#4F46E5), dark slate-900 typography, emerald-600 for positive changes/success, amber-500 accents.

Page Sections & Components:
1. Header / Page Title Row:
   - Left: Title 'Dashboard overview' (font-semibold text-2xl text-slate-900), subtitle 'Real-time performance metrics, sales conversion, and student learning trends across BICE Data Academy.'
   - Right: Action group: 'Export Report' button (outlined secondary with download icon) and primary indigo-600 'Download Financial Statement' or '+ New Announcement'.

2. KPI Cards Row (5 horizontal compact cards in a responsive grid):
   - Card 1: 'Total Students' -> Value: '1,248' | Subtext/Pill: '+42 this month' (emerald-600 pill with trending up icon) | Icon: User Group in soft indigo circle.
   - Card 2: 'Total Courses' -> Value: '12' | Subtext: 'Across 4 data domains' | Icon: BookOpen icon.
   - Card 3: 'Total Enrollments' -> Value: '3,540' | Subtext: '+185 active sessions' | Icon: GraduationCap / layers icon.
   - Card 4: 'Total Revenue' -> Value: '₹48,20,000' | Subtext: 'Lifetime gross' | Icon: Indian Rupee / Banknote icon.
   - Card 5: 'Monthly Revenue' -> Value: '₹6,12,400' | Subtext: '+18% vs last month' (emerald pill with spark arrow) | Icon: TrendingUp icon.

3. Analytics & Charts Row (2 columns, 8 cols / 4 cols or balanced 7 / 5):
   - Left Chart Card (Wide): 'Revenue trend (last 12 months)'
     - Card header: Title 'Revenue trend (last 12 months)', subtitle 'Monthly gross earnings in INR', right-side toggle pills: 'Monthly', 'Quarterly', with legend indicator (indigo dot 'Course Sales', slate-300 dot 'Enterprise Subscriptions').
     - Chart Visualization: High-fidelity Recharts-style SVG area chart with clean gradient fill (indigo-600 fading to indigo-50), smooth cubic bezier curves, horizontal grid lines with value labels (₹2L, ₹4L, ₹6L, ₹8L), month axis labels on bottom (Nov, Dec, Jan, Feb, Mar, Apr, May, Jun, Jul, Aug, Sep, Oct), and an interactive hover tooltip simulation showing 'Oct 2024: ₹6,12,400 (+18.4% YoY)'.
   - Right Chart Card: 'Enrollments by category'
     - Card header: Title 'Enrollments by category', subtitle 'Distribution of 3,540 learners', dropdown filter 'All Time'.
     - Chart Visualization: A clean SVG donut chart with elegant corporate color segments:
       * Advanced Excel & Financial Modeling: 38% (Indigo-600 #4F46E5)
       * SQL & Data Warehousing: 26% (Cyan-500 #06B6D4)
       * Power Query & ETL: 20% (Emerald-500 #10B981)
       * Python & Executive BI: 16% (Amber-500 #F59E0B)
     - Center text of donut: '3,540 Total Enrollments'.
     - Clean breakdown legend below the donut with dot color, category title, percentage, and exact student count.

4. Operations & Activity Row (3 column layout or 2:1 balanced grid):
   - Column 1: 'Recent purchases' Table Card (High-density clean data table):
     - Table header with search input and 'View all orders ->' link.
     - Columns:
       * ORDER ID (e.g. #ORD-9842, #ORD-9841, #ORD-9840, #ORD-9839, #ORD-9838)
       * STUDENT (Avatar thumbnail, full name e.g. Samantha Patel, Rohan Gupta, Elena Rostova, Marcus Chen, David Kalu)
       * COURSE (Course name with level badge: 'Advanced Excel Masterclass', 'SQL for Modern Data Analysis', 'Power Query & Automated ETL', 'Python for Business Dashboards')
       * AMOUNT (₹4,999, ₹7,999, ₹6,499, ₹8,999)
       * STATUS (Pill badge: 'Paid' in green bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 font-medium, or 'Processing')
       * DATE (Today 14:20, Today 11:05, Yesterday, Oct 29)
     - Table footer with pagination info: 'Showing 5 of 480 orders'.

   - Column 2: 'Recent registrations' List Card:
     - Header: 'Recent registrations' with '38 joined today' badge.
     - Stacked list items with user initials/avatar, full name, email address (e.g. 'priya.s@deloitte.com', 'arun.k@mckinsey.com', 'neha.v@amazon.com'), target track tag, and relative timestamp ('4 mins ago', '18 mins ago', '1 hour ago', '3 hours ago').
     - Footer: 'View all 1,248 students' action button.

   - Column 3: 'Most popular courses' Ranked List Card:
     - Header: 'Most popular courses', subtitle 'By enrollment velocity & revenue'.
     - Ranked list with rank number pill (1, 2, 3, 4):
       * 1. 'Advanced Excel Masterclass': 1,420 enrolled, mini progress bar (88% fill), ₹14.2L revenue.
       * 2. 'SQL for Modern Data Analysis': 980 enrolled, mini progress bar (62% fill), ₹11.8L revenue.
       * 3. 'Power Query & Automated ETL': 640 enrolled, mini progress bar (42% fill), ₹7.9L revenue.
       * 4. 'Python for Business Dashboards': 500 enrolled, mini progress bar (34% fill), ₹6.8L revenue.
     - Performance summary footer note: 'Top 2 courses generate 54% of total academy revenue.'
